biological_replicate.evidence: inferred: Plasma proteome profiling on 48 patients with cirrhosis or NAFLD with normal glucose tolerance or diabetes, revealed 8 significantly changing (ALDOB, APOM, LGALS3BP, PIGR, VTN, IGHD, FCGBP and AFM), two of which are already linked to liver disease.

experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Two‐sample Student's t‐test was used to determine the significantly changed proteins between disease and control groups with a permutation‐based FDR of 0.05.
